k223403727.notes: Large metal letters curving around the rounded corner of the Capital City building on Independence Avenue, Victoria; the name continues out of view, so only 'CAPITAL C...' is visible and the last letters are steeply foreshortened. Dashcam view; parked 4x4 in front.

k223403601.notes: Blue panel on the glass front of Al Salam Bank Seychelles, Victoria. Between 'مصرف' and 'AL SALAM BANK' is a droplet-shaped calligraphic logo of the bank name (السلام) that is too stylised to transcribe as text. The slogan 'Dynamic. Diversified. Differentiated.' is advertising copy; the truck of 'Paradise' juice boxes is a distractor.

k223403581.notes: Brown balcony banners of an internet café, Victoria, shot upward through a windscreen with a yellow glare blob over the left banner. The 'O' of the name is an @ swirl. A white 'Welcome to Y@WNET! INTERNET CYBER / WE ARE OPEN NOW' banner at the right has small unreadable lines.
